briefing.headline: OpenAI and Google escalate frontier race with o4 and Gemini 3.0 launches amid rising safety concerns

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies as multiple labs push new frontier models while compute constraints and regulatory scrutiny mount. Prompt injection attacks continue to dominate production incidents. Investment remains robust across infrastructure and safety tooling.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with enhanced reasoning; Anthropic launched Claude 4 Opus; Google deployed Gemini 3.0; Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B; xAI advanced Grok-3; DeepSeek introduced V3. Multi-agent coordination benchmarks show rapid gains.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra shipments; Microsoft and Google expanded data center capacity by 40% YoY; TSMC reports AI chip demand outstripping supply through 2027.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the capability gap with closed frontier labs before 2027?
